subject.title: feat: add commands list and inspect inventory

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `openclaw commands` as a separate operator/developer inventory and permanently add `effectProfile`, `commandExposure`, and `hidden` to the public plugin CLI descriptor contract?
rationale: The patch is coherent and proven, but it creates a new public versioned command schema beside an existing Gateway inventory and expands a shipped external plugin API; only maintainers can choose that permanent product and compatibility boundary.

options.title: Adopt and rebase
options.body: Approve the separate local inventory and advisory plugin fields, then require a conflict-free rebase onto current plugin contract modules before merge.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Land the core local inventory without plugin descriptor API additions and revisit plugin metadata through the RFC.

options.title: Design one shared schema
options.body: Pause this branch and converge local CLI and Gateway consumers on a single canonical inventory model before implementation.

recommendation.title: Adopt and rebase
recommendation.body: Approve the separate local inventory and advisory plugin fields, then require a conflict-free rebase onto current plugin contract modules before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is an RFC-level public CLI and external plugin SDK choice, and the PR explicitly routed that decision to this repository owner.
